questions.stem: The airport authority sent a COVID-19 suspect patient to the designated district hospital for a consultation. He came positive on RT-PCR testing. As the duty doctor, you observe that he has mild symptoms that can be treated on an outpatient basis. What will be your recommendation?

options.label: A
options.text: Home isolation for 7 days from testing positive

options.label: B
options.text: Home quarantine for 10 days from testing positive

options.label: C
options.text: Home isolation for 10 days from testing positive

options.label: D
options.text: Home quarantine for 7 days from testing positive
